title: 第七章 万有引力请阁下赴死第八章 临界
lines: 章节摘要：“反重力引擎？不过是花哨的磁悬浮。切断电源，它就是铁棺材。“——牛顿
安全屋的地下二层，有一间没有标牌的房间。
里面堆着各种拆解到一半的设备残骸，角落里有个焊接台，台面烧得坑坑洼洼。阿琳把这里叫“修理间“，实际上是破晓用来改装武器的地方。
叶清欢在这里待了两天半。
宁修远第一天去找她的时候，她正蹲在地上，把一个报废的电磁线圈拆开，把里面的铜芯一圈一圈绕到另一个骨架上。手法精细，速度很快，眼睛里没有焦距，像是在做一件不需要思考的事情。
“在做什么？“
“给你做一个东西。“她头也没抬，“坐着等。“
宁修远在旁边的废铁箱上坐了二十分钟，看着她工作。
她不说话的时候，能量指示灯发出均匀的蓝光，机械触须收拢在装甲里，只有手指在动，安静得像一台精密的仪器在完成某项程序。
但偶尔，她会把某个零件拿到眼前看一下，歪一下头，再放回去——那个动作，让她看起来像在犯难，像在想某件很小但很认真的事。
宁修远没有打扰她。
四十分钟后，她站起来，把一个手掌大的装置递给他。
外壳是用废旧义体零件拼的，不好看，但结构紧凑。
“电磁***。“叶清欢说，“有效半径十五米，持续时间八秒，对义体和机械设备都有效。“
宁修远翻来覆去看了看：“你自己做的？“
“嗯。“她歪头，“但只有三个。铜芯不够了。“
牛顿在宁修远脑海里扫描了一下，声音带着一点不情愿的赞赏：
“频率调得不错。能压制筑基初期修士的义体，也能干扰低阶法器的能量回路。“
他停了一下：
“这个机器人的工程能力，比我预想的强。“
叶清欢当然听不见，但宁修远把这话转述了一遍。
她听完，想了两秒，说：
“告诉他，谢谢。“
然后转身继续蹲下来找零件，背影一副事不关己的模样。
牛顿沉默了三秒：
任务简报在第三天凌晨五点。
作战室里，秦墨站在地图前，手边放着三张情报截图。
“天道院今天上午，会有一支物资运输队，从东区仓库出发，前往浮空城补给站。“
他指了指高架桥的位置：“路线经过这里。“
“三辆浮空运输车，护卫六人，全部筑基初期。“秦墨扫了一圈在场的十几个破晓成员，“情报来自内线，可信度85%。“
“任务目标：截获物资，不强求歼灭护卫，能跑就跑。“
他看向宁修远：
“你负责车。“
宁修远低头看着手里那三个电磁***，没说话，点了下头。
“你负责什么？“叶清欢在他旁边，声音很平，大概是对秦墨说的。
“统筹。“秦墨说。
叶清欢歪了歪头，在心里显然算了一下“统筹“的战斗价值，然后没有评论。
秦墨看了她一眼，嘴角动了一下，没说什么。
清晨的废土，雾还没散。
宁修远跟着队伍穿过三片废墟区，在高架桥下集结。
阿琳已经在桥墩下布好了炸药，引爆线藏在混凝土缝里，不仔细看找不到。
content_en:
Chapter summary: "Anti-gravity engine? Just fancy maglev. Cut off the power and it's an iron coffin." - Newton
There is an unmarked room on the second underground floor of the safe house.
There were various half-disassembled pieces of equipment piled inside. There was a welding station in the corner, and the tabletop was burnt and pitted. Arlene calls this place the "repair room", but it's actually a place used by Dawn to modify weapons.
Ye Qinghuan stayed here for two and a half days.
When Ning Xiuyuan went to find her on the first day, she was squatting on the ground, taking apart a scrapped electromagnetic coil and winding the copper core inside around another frame. The technique is delicate and the speed is very fast. There is no focus in the eyes, as if he is doing something that does not require thinking.
"What are you doing?"
"Make something for you." She said without raising her head, "Sit and wait."
Ning Xiuyuan sat on the scrap iron box next to him for twenty minutes, watching her work.
When she wasn't talking, the energy indicator light emitted a uniform blue light, and the mechanical tentacles were retracted in the armor. Only her fingers were moving, as quietly as a precise instrument completing a certain program.
But occasionally, she would bring a certain part to her eyes, look at it, tilt her head, and put it back again - that action made her look like she was having trouble, like she was thinking about something small but serious.
Ning Xiuyuan did not disturb her.
Forty minutes later, she stood up and handed him a device as big as the palm of her hand.
The shell is made of discarded prosthetic parts. It doesn't look good, but it has a compact structure.
"Electromagnetic attack." Ye Qinghuan said, "The effective radius is fifteen meters and the duration is eight seconds. It is effective on both prosthetics and mechanical equipment."
Ning Xiuyuan looked over and over: "Did you do it yourself?"
"Yeah." She tilted her head, "But there are only three. The copper core is not enough."
Newton scanned Ning Xiuyuan's mind, and his voice contained a bit of reluctant appreciation:
"The frequency is adjusted well. It can suppress the prosthetic bodies of monks in the early stages of foundation building, and it can also interfere with the energy circuits of low-level magic weapons."
He paused:
"The engineering capabilities of this robot are stronger than I expected."
Of course Ye Qinghuan couldn't hear it, but Ning Xiuyuan relayed the words.
After listening, she thought for two seconds and said:
"Tell him thank you."
Then he turned around and continued to squat down to look for parts. His back looked like it had nothing to do with him.
Newton was silent for three seconds:
"...Tsk."
The mission briefing was at five o'clock in the morning on the third day.
In the war room, Qin Mo stood in front of the map with three intelligence screenshots in his hand.
"Tiandaoyuan will have a material transportation team depart from the East District Warehouse this morning and go to the Floating City Supply Station."
He pointed to the location of the viaduct: "The route passes here."
"Three floating transport vehicles, with six escorts, all in the early stage of foundation building." Qin Mo glanced at the dozen Dawn members present, "The information comes from inside sources, and the credibility is 85%."
"Mission goal: intercept supplies, annihilate the guards without forcing them, just run away if you can."
He looked at Ning Xiuyuan:
"You're in charge of the car."
Ning Xiuyuan looked down at the three electromagnetic guns in his hand, said nothing, and nodded.
"What are you responsible for?" Ye Qinghuan was next to him, his voice was calm, and he probably said to Qin Mo.
"Coordinator." Qin Mo said.
Ye Qinghuan tilted his head, apparently calculating the combat value of "coordination" in his mind, and then made no comment.
Qin Mo glanced at her, moved the corner of his mouth, but said nothing.
In the wasteland in the early morning, the fog has not cleared yet.
Ning Xiuyuan followed the team through three ruins and gathered under the viaduct.
Arlene has already planted explosives under the bridge piers, and the detonating wires are hidden in the cracks in the concrete. They cannot be found unless you look carefully.
